title: Bean Royale
tagline: Twenty beans. Four rounds. One crown.
description: The full 3D show: procedurally modelled jelly-bean characters with real animation, lit obstacle courses, a chase camera, AI rivals, cosmetics and trophies. Twenty beans enter, the field shrinks every round, and one bean grabs the crown.
controls: WASD move · SPACE jump · SHIFT dive · E grab
